summary.text: Anne Brensley, a Republican attorney and business executive and former Wayland Select Board member, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth to William Galvin.

paragraphs.text: Brensley is an attorney and business executive; her campaign describes her as CEO of DevCo North America with more than 100 real estate transactions.
She graduated from Suffolk University School of Law in 2008.
She was adopted from Honduras as a child.
She was elected to the Wayland Select Board in 2023.

In 2025 she sought the Republican nomination for lieutenant governor, and in July 2026, after not qualifying for the ballot in that race, she announced a write-in campaign for Secretary of the Commonwealth.
During the campaign, she emphasized business growth, voter engagement and ballot integrity, including Portuguese-language ballots.
She received 28.7% of the vote to William Galvin's 71.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
The Fall River Reporter described Brensley as the first Latina nominated for statewide office by a major party in Massachusetts.
